subject: english
question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error.

There will be many important lessons to be learn from the COVID-19 pandemic.
solution:
The erroneous part is:** lessons to be learn**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect form "**learn**." It should be "**learned**" to match the grammatical structure.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**lessons to be learned**," because after** 'be'**, the** 'ed'** form of **verb **must be used.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 2** of the sentence.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"There will be many important lessons to be learned from the COVID-19 pandemic."*
